prompt.alinti: You've just found a powerful way to map out complex investigations. Imagine you're trying to solve a messy puzzle where you need to connect the dots between websites, crypto wallets, and company records all at once. That's exactly what this tool called FlowSynth does for people working in security and research. It's essentially a digital whiteboard that automatically builds a map of how different pieces of information relate to each other. Instead of digging through thousands of disconnected files or browser tabs, you get a clean visual graph that shows you the big picture instantly. It's like having a high-tech detective's wall where lines appear automatically between clues so you can see the story behind the data. This project has already caught the attention of the tech community, sitting at a solid 8,398 stars on GitHub right now. You can even set it up on your own computer to keep your findings completely private and secure while you explore. It's a really clever way to make sense of the overwhelming amount of data we deal with every single day.

yontem.alinti: Flowsint is an open-source OSINT graph exploration tool designed for ethical investigation, transparency, and verification.
